definitions.explanation: A form of criminal punishment in the Japanese legal system where the convicted person is confined to prison but not required to perform labor. Lighter than imprisonment with labor but heavier than a fine.

examples.japanese: {禁錮|きんこ}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}された→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: A sentence of three years' imprisonment was handed down.

examples.japanese: {禁錮|きんこ}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処|しょ}せられる→処する：30647_shosuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Anyone sentenced to imprisonment or above cannot become a civil servant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{業務上過失致死|ぎょうむじょうかしつちし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{禁錮|きんこ}2⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧、⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧4⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant received a sentence of two years' imprisonment, suspended for four years, for professional negligence resulting in death.

notes: Composed of ⟦{禁|きん}→禁：28295_kin⟧ (prohibit, confine) + {錮|こ} (imprison). Also written {禁固|きんこ}. In Japanese criminal law, the traditional distinction is: ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧ (imprisonment with labor) vs. {禁錮|きんこ} (imprisonment without labor). {禁錮|きんこ} was typically applied to negligent crimes rather than intentional ones. Note: Japan's 2022 Penal Code reform merged ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧ and {禁錮|きんこ} into a new unified category called {拘禁刑|こうきんけい} (effective 2025). Common collocations: {禁錮|きんこ}〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (~ years' imprisonment), {禁錮|きんこ}⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧ (imprisonment sentence). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{金庫|きんこ}→金庫：01749_kinko⟧ (safe, vault).
